goal.objective: Write-path canary for the bounded BirdAI Qwen executor. Create exactly .birdai/canary/qwen-write-smoke.txt with the single line BIRDAI_QWEN_WRITE_SMOKE_PASS followed by one newline. Do not inspect, read, search, or modify any other repository file. After writing the canary, immediately call structured_output exactly once with a schema-valid result.
goal.pass_definition: The canary file exists with exactly the required bytes, BirdAI reports it as the only changed file, authoritative validation exits 0, and the publisher opens a review PR.

validation.command: from pathlib import Path; p=Path('.birdai/canary/qwen-write-smoke.txt'); assert p.is_file(), 'canary missing'; assert p.read_bytes() == b'BIRDAI_QWEN_WRITE_SMOKE_PASS\n', repr(p.read_bytes()); print('WRITE_SMOKE: PASS')
